entities.summary: Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with South India, including the modern Indian states of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Telangana. Most Carnatic compositions are in Telugu and Sanskrit languages. Carnatic music is a music genre, created circa 1100. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
